source: RFC 0003 §4.4 (the future of a maintenance call)
statement: The future of `revalidate` or `recompile` completes only after, for every document it covers, a load that started after the call: `revalidate` covers every document installed at the call, `recompile` every app and tenant document idle or loading at the call. A load already in flight at the call, which may have read or compiled before it, is followed by another, and the future waits for that one.
guards: runtime:SnapshotRecompileTest#recompiling waits for a document that was loading, until it is compiled with the new inputs
runtime:KeyDrainLaneTest#a load of an absent key that ends before its recompile mark is taken is followed by a read after the call
